```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[array] --> M[map: transform -> new]
```

sections.title: Array methods
sections.content:
```ruby
nums = [1, 2, 3, 4]

nums.map { |n| n * 2 }        # [2, 4, 6, 8]   (new array)
nums.select { |n| n.even? }   # [2, 4]         (keep matches)
nums.reject { |n| n.even? }  # [1, 3]         (drop matches)
nums.find { |n| n > 2 }       # 3              (first match; nil if none)
nums.reduce(0) { |s, n| s + n } # 10          (fold to one value)
nums.sort                    # [1, 2, 3, 4]
nums.sort_by { |n| -n }       # [4, 3, 2, 1]   (sort by key)
nums.each { |n| puts n }     # prints 1..4; returns original (not a new array)
nums.uniq                    # dedupe
nums.include?(3)             # true (membership)
nums.flatten                 # [[1,2],[3]] -> [1,2,3]

# map vs each: map returns a NEW array; each returns the ORIGINAL.
[1,2,3].each { |n| n * 10 }  # returns [1,2,3]  (NOT [10,20,30])
[1,2,3].map  { |n| n * 10 }  # returns [10,20,30]

# Bang versions mutate in place:
a = [1,2,3]; a.map! { |n| n*10 }; a  # [10,20,30]

# Composition (read left to right):
nums.select { |n| n.even? }.map { |n| n * 10 }  # [20, 40]
```

```ruby
nums = [1, 2, 3, 4]

nums.map { |n| n * 2 }        # [2, 4, 6, 8]   (new array)
nums.select { |n| n.even? }   # [2, 4]         (keep matches)
nums.reject { |n| n.even? }  # [1, 3]         (drop matches)
nums.find { |n| n > 2 }       # 3              (first match; nil if none)
nums.reduce(0) { |s, n| s + n } # 10          (fold to one value)
nums.sort                    # [1, 2, 3, 4]
nums.sort_by { |n| -n }       # [4, 3, 2, 1]   (sort by key)
nums.each { |n| puts n }     # prints 1..4; returns original (not a new array)
nums.uniq                    # dedupe
nums.include?(3)             # true (membership)
nums.flatten                 # [[1,2],[3]] -> [1,2,3]

# map vs each: map returns a NEW array; each returns the ORIGINAL.
[1,2,3].each { |n| n * 10 }  # returns [1,2,3]  (NOT [10,20,30])
[1,2,3].map  { |n| n * 10 }  # returns [10,20,30]

# Bang versions mutate in place:
a = [1,2,3]; a.map! { |n| n*10 }; a  # [10,20,30]

# Composition (read left to right):
nums.select { |n| n.even? }.map { |n| n * 10 }  # [20, 40]
```
